title: I work deploying a bunch of OpenClaw agents. OpenClaw has become bloa...
first_user: I work deploying a bunch of OpenClaw agents. OpenClaw has become bloated. I’m debating building my own harness based on Elixir’s primitives. The core should be a lean harness like Pi (but written in Elixir) Be extensible with plugins, skills, subagents, etc. It should communicate through Slack and be accessible via the TUI, too. It should not be a personal agent, it should focus on working with a team of people. Let’s do some wayfinder to find the minimum viable product we can ship to test this out.
